components.title: Ingestion transport integration
components.intent: Wires separate HTTP and gRPC pipelines; carries stream identity into processing and constructs the completion barrier from returned effects and scheduled promises.
gaps: The real driver must include every required side effect in its settlement promise. The gRPC server tests substitute a FakeDriver, so they do not establish this.

components.title: Admission and acknowledgment
components.intent: Accepts bounded client streams, grants feed capacity in arrival order, and acknowledges accepted batches after their driver-provided settlement barrier. Cancellation and shutdown retire waiting or accepted work.

components.title: Batch execution and result routing
components.intent: Tracks accepted batches and their capacity. Routes explicit OK, DROP, DLQ and REDIRECT results; preserves associated effects for scheduling or settlement.

components.title: Shared ingestion recipe
components.intent: Composes parsing, team resolution, event processing, warnings, result routing and side effects. The same skeleton supplies multiple ingestion products; this adoption examines only the selected worker path.

components.title: Parsing and team resolution
components.intent: Turns transport headers and payloads into events and resolves the team before team-aware processing. Unknown tokens can be dropped without halting the rest of a batch.
gaps: These selected pipeline fixtures do not prove tenant isolation across every caller, bypass or downstream store.

components.title: Analytics processing
components.intent: Assembles event restrictions, per-identity processing and batched store flushes for analytics ingestion. Uses the shared recipe and declares typed output destinations.
gaps: Person merges, overflow policy, event transformation and real-store writes are outside this executable slice.

components.title: Output destinations
components.intent: Provides named destinations to the result router. Dead-letter and redirected records become producer effects; ordinary successful events continue on the processing path.
gaps: Fake-producer tests do not establish Kafka durability, delivery uniqueness or the completeness of configured destinations.

components.title: Deferred effect scheduler
components.intent: Tracks outstanding promises, removes them on settlement, and exposes explicit wait-for-all or wait-for-all-settled barriers. This slice includes only that utility.

claims.invariant: an accepted sub-batch remains in flight until its driver settlement completes
claims.oracle: records an accepted sub-batch in the shared in-flight metrics until it settles
parameters: Success ack placed on the originating stream queue
Rejected settlement poisons the pipeline and fails affected streams; the selected oracle directly tests only the unresolved barrier
claims.excludes: This named oracle observes in-flight accounting. Historical wait-removal mutation sensitivity does not prove all early-ack defects or downstream durability; the driver is fake.
claims.falsifier: Hold the accepted batch settlement unresolved and observe its in-flight count retired.
claims.boundary: boundary "an accepted sub-batch remains in flight until its driver settlement completes" at WorkerIngestServer via guard "records an accepted sub-batch in the shared in-flight metrics until it settles"

claims.invariant: shutdown waits for accepted sub-batch acknowledgments within its drain budget
claims.oracle: stop() drains in-flight sub-batch acks before ending streams
parameters: stop sets draining and aborts new admission
Sub-batches already fed to the driver
Settled batches acknowledged before ending streams
Fail remaining streams after the deadline; a poisoned pipeline skips draining
claims.falsifier: Start shutdown with a pending accepted batch and observe the stream close before its settlement and acknowledgment within the budget.
claims.boundary: boundary "shutdown waits for accepted sub-batch acknowledgments within its drain budget" at WorkerIngestServer via guard "stop() drains in-flight sub-batch acks before ending streams"

claims.invariant: a cancelled queued stream does not consume the next live feed slot
claims.oracle: drops a cancelled stream from the admission queue so its slot skips to a live stream
parameters: A granted slot belongs to one live feed attempt
Remove queued waiter; release an already-granted slot when cancellation wins before use
claims.falsifier: Cancel the front waiter, release capacity, and observe it consumed by the cancelled stream instead of the next live waiter.
claims.boundary: boundary "a cancelled queued stream does not consume the next live feed slot" at WorkerIngestServer via guard "drops a cancelled stream from the admission queue so its slot skips to a live stream"

claims.invariant: live streams acquire feed slots in arrival order
claims.oracle: grants feed slots in arrival order across streams instead of racing
parameters: Current holders eventually release capacity; no claim of scheduler fairness outside this queue
claims.falsifier: Queue multiple live streams and observe a later arrival acquire the next slot before the earlier waiter.
claims.boundary: boundary "live streams acquire feed slots in arrival order" at WorkerIngestServer via guard "grants feed slots in arrival order across streams instead of racing"

claims.invariant: stream admission refuses work beyond the configured total concurrency ceiling
claims.oracle: refuses a stream past the total concurrency ceiling with ResourceExhausted
claims.falsifier: Keep maxStreams live streams open and observe one additional stream accepted.
claims.boundary: boundary "stream admission refuses work beyond the configured total concurrency ceiling" at WorkerIngestServer via guard "refuses a stream past the total concurrency ceiling with ResourceExhausted"

claims.invariant: batch feed refuses excess concurrent batches until capacity is released
claims.oracle: feed() accepts when under limit and rejects when at limit
parameters: Draining a completed batch releases its slot
claims.falsifier: Fill concurrentBatches slots and observe another nonempty batch accepted without a drain.
claims.boundary: boundary "batch feed refuses excess concurrent batches until capacity is released" at BatchingPipeline via guard "feed() accepts when under limit and rejects when at limit"

claims.invariant: dead-letter results retain the producer effect in their result context
claims.oracle: should handle dlq results and add side effects
claims.boundary: boundary "dead-letter results retain the producer effect in their result context" at ResultHandlingPipeline via guard "should handle dlq results and add side effects"

claims.invariant: redirect results retain the destination producer effect in their result context
claims.oracle: should handle redirected results and add side effects
claims.boundary: boundary "redirect results retain the destination producer effect in their result context" at ResultHandlingPipeline via guard "should handle redirected results and add side effects"

claims.invariant: inline effect handling waits for settlement before clearing effect context
claims.oracle: should await side effects and clear them from context
claims.boundary: boundary "inline effect handling waits for settlement before clearing effect context" at SideEffectHandlingPipeline via guard "should await side effects and clear them from context"

claims.invariant: unresolved event tokens are dropped while other events continue
claims.oracle: drops events whose token cannot be resolved and keeps processing the rest
claims.boundary: boundary "unresolved event tokens are dropped while other events continue" at newCommonIngestionPipeline via guard "drops events whose token cannot be resolved and keeps processing the rest"

claims.invariant: the shared recipe routes dead-letter results to the configured output
claims.oracle: produces DLQ results from steps to the DLQ output
claims.boundary: boundary "the shared recipe routes dead-letter results to the configured output" at newCommonIngestionPipeline via guard "produces DLQ results from steps to the DLQ output"

claims.invariant: the shared recipe routes redirect results to the configured output
claims.oracle: produces redirect results to the configured redirect output
claims.boundary: boundary "the shared recipe routes redirect results to the configured output" at newCommonIngestionPipeline via guard "produces redirect results to the configured redirect output"

claims.invariant: waitForAll waits for the scheduled promise population it observes
claims.oracle: should wait for all scheduled promises
claims.boundary: boundary "waitForAll waits for the scheduled promise population it observes" at PromiseScheduler via guard "should wait for all scheduled promises"

relies: The transport composition installs WorkerIngestServer to own the settlement-to-ack boundary.
The real driver feeds and drains BatchingPipeline through the joined pipeline.
GrpcStreamIngestDriver.next includes promiseScheduler.waitForAll in its settlement promise.
The driver interface returns the framework FeedResult and admission is aligned with pipeline capacity.
The shared builder installs result handling after the event processing steps.
The shared builder delegates redirect effect construction to result handling.
The common builder receives the scheduler used for detached step and hook effects.
The joined analytics pipeline uses the shared recipe to resolve teams before team-aware steps.
limitations: Root-alias imports are currently unresolved by Coherence.
Binding flow endpoints cannot cross ownership seams.
Colocated tests are pinned as evidence but excluded from runtime graph mass.
Catalog definitions are candidate vocabulary; no new portability claim.
